result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers keep radius at zero, avoid blurred shadows and keep motion small. A goes further: it uses hard offset shadows and thick rules to separate raised, overlay and pressed states, and it gives ready-to-paste reduced-motion CSS plus a clear hover/press pattern. B is clean and appropriately small, but using bare border widths as elevation is less expressive, its reduced-motion handling is only described in words, and its 'Checks' section adds filler. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers keep radius at zero, avoid blurred shadows and keep motion minimal. B fits the brand better: its hard-offset elevation and pressed-state collapse feel blunt and tactile, and it ships the reduced-motion media query as real code. A is tighter and clearer about what it leaves out, but its depth system is only border weights and it describes the reduced-motion rule without giving the code, while B pads a little with color and z-index tokens.
